summary: The Brooklyn dossiers were mostly sound on long-established history, geography and 2026-27 league facts, which match the verified current facts. The sharpest errors were a closed restaurant (Clover Hill, closed October 2025), a wrong Navy Yard practice-facility claim, an Atlantic Terminal subway-line count, a Barclays ownership misstatement and an over-long Biggie lyric quote; all were fixed in place. The live checks confirmed Atlantic Antic (Sept 27, 2026, possibly moved to Oct 4) and found only dated Brooklyn Circus listings. The strategy brief needs editing: the Nov 3 anniversary is the 14th (start of the 15th season), the Still a City uniform must become conditional if the ABA throwbacks are the City Edition, and the Paramount-floor launch and several named doors and partners are unverified.
